name: Make Missed Lead Follow-up
description: Detects a lead that has not received a timely human response, sends one approved follow-up message, and stops automatically when the conversation resumes.

steps.description: Query leads whose last inbound message is older than the approved response threshold.
Exclude opted-out, closed, already-followed-up, or recently answered conversations.
Send one approved message through the configured channel without inventing urgency or discounts.
Record the follow-up timestamp and stop future sends when a reply or human update appears.

privacy.notes: Use the minimum contact fields, honor opt-outs immediately, restrict scenario logs, and delete stale lead records according to the business retention policy.

testing: Create an eligible synthetic lead and confirm exactly one follow-up is sent after the threshold.
Mark a lead as opted out and confirm the scenario never sends a message.
Add a human response before the scheduled follow-up and confirm the message is cancelled.
